article.story: WEST POINT, N.Y. -- — Dywane Chess had 19 points, Jordan Gabriel scored 17 and Marist beat Army 73-68 on Tuesday. Chess and Gabriel both grabbed six rebounds for the Red Foxes (2-3) and Edward Onyia hit two 3-pointers and scored 12. Ryan Curry finished with 27 points, six assists and four steals for the Black Knights (2-3). Dylan Benner had 10 points. Gabriel scored 11 points in the first half and Marist went into halftime trailing 41-35. Chess scored 13 second-half points and Marist secured the victory after a second half that featured five lead changes. Up next for Marist is a matchup Tuesday with Bryant at home. Army visits Binghamton on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
